item.title: Kai Cenat becomes first streamer ever to hit 20 million followers on Twitch
item.description: Kai Cenat has shattered Twitch records, becoming the first streamer to amass 20 million followers. His authentic energy, humor, and engaging chat interaction have propelled him to global fame. Hard work, innovative "Mafiathon" events featuring celebrity guests, and a loyal fanbase have cemented his position as a streaming powerhouse, influencing brand perceptions.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is Adamn Killa? TikToker who went viral after Chicago police held him for saying Arrest Me Daddy
item.description: Chicago rapper and TikTok creator Adamn Killa, real name Adam Kelly, was briefly detained by police after interrupting a traffic stop with his viral "Arrest me, Daddy" catchphrase. He was handcuffed and held for 20 minutes before being released without charges. The incident, widely reported by major news outlets, further boosted his online presence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Candace Owens and Allie Beth Stuckey spark big drama as new words on Charlie Kirk assassination go viral
item.description: Candace Owens responded to Allie Beth Stuckey's video, which Owens felt targeted her investigation into Charlie Kirk's murder. Owens stated she was personally hurt and advised Stuckey to take a break. Stuckey later expressed being genuinely wounded by Owens' remarks, emphasizing her concern for justice and the potential harm of unproven claims in the sensitive case.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘Americans are smarter than Indians’: MAGA activist’s Indian IQ rant sparks backlash
item.description: A MAGA activist's claim that Americans are smarter than Indians sparked a fierce debate. Data-driven rebuttals highlighted Indian Americans' high incomes and educational achievements, countering the activist's IQ-based argument. The incident underscores the critical role of skilled immigration in addressing US workforce shortages, a reality that data consistently supports over nationalist slogans.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Rakai banned from TikTok Live and the reason is funnier than you think
item.description: Creator Rakai faced immediate TikTok Live ban within two minutes for attempting to sell ultra-rare Freddy Krueger Nike Dunks, valued at $80,000, for just $500. The sneakers, reportedly stolen from Duke Dennis of AMP, sparked disbelief and viral reactions. This impulsive, drastically underpriced sale quickly became a social media spectacle, highlighting influencer group tensions.

item.title: Hitler’s DNA reveals he possibly had micropenis, one testicle and severe sexual-development issues
item.description: New DNA analysis of Adolf Hitler's blood-stained sofa fabric reveals potential developmental abnormalities. Researchers found markers suggesting Kallmann syndrome and genital abnormalities. The study also debunks myths of Jewish ancestry. While genetic links to conditions like autism are noted, experts stress genetics do not determine behavior or ideology. This scientific exploration provides biological context but does not explain his actions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Tension escalates between N3on and Chloe Parker after dispute tied to $5,000 bag goes viral
item.description: A public spat between streamer N3on and ex-girlfriend Chloe Parker erupted over a $5,000 designer bag. N3on's livestream comments, perceived as indirect criticism, prompted Chloe's fiery response, accusing him of airing private matters and misrepresenting the situation. She demanded an apology, highlighting his public shaming and its impact on her reputation, as the feud escalates online.

item.title: ‘They know Asmongold?’: HasanAbi’s stunned reaction to the streamer’s global fame breaks the internet
item.description: Streamer Asmongold discovered his surprising popularity in China, leaving fellow streamer HasanAbi in disbelief. Asmongold's content, particularly his opinions on Black Myth: Wukong, has garnered millions of views on Bilibili, despite a past ban. This unexpected reach highlights the global interconnectedness of gaming audiences.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: What is Beast Land? Everything to know about MrBeast’s first-ever theme park in Saudi Arabia
item.description: MrBeast's highly anticipated theme park, Beast Land, is now open in Riyadh. This 45-day pop-up brings his famous YouTube challenges to life with exciting rides and obstacle courses. Fans can experience the creator's chaotic world firsthand. Beast Land is a bold step for creator-driven brands, potentially setting a new standard for offline entertainment experiences.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: 'Ramaswamy called Ohioans lazy, mediocre': Ohio Guv election campaigning heats up after Trump endorses Vivek
item.description: Ohio gubernatorial candidates Vivek Ramaswamy and Dr Amy Acton are trading barbs after an outlier poll projected Acton to be edging past Ramaswamy. Acton criticized Ramaswamy's past H-1B comments, calling Ohioans lazy, while Ramaswamy attacked Acton's COVID-19 lockdown policies. Despite being cornered in MAGA, Vivek got a thumping endorsement from President Trump.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bride dies on wedding day just hours after saying ‘I do’ to childhood sweetheart
item.description: Jade Tabrar, 37, married her soulmate, Adam Kemp, 42, in a heartfelt ceremony on November 3, 2025, just hours before passing away in his arms. Jade, a mother of five, had been battling advanced stomach cancer. The couple, together for 19 years, rushed to marry after Jade was given only months to live.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Oman cultural visa 2025 : Here's how artists, researchers can live, work, and bring their families along
item.description: Oman has launched a new Cultural Visa and Residence category, effective November 10, 2025, offering long-term stays of up to ten years for creative professionals. This initiative, with affordable fees and family inclusion, aims to attract global talent and diversify the economy as part of Oman Vision 2040.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Freeze all immigration until...: US Congressman Chip Roy attacks Sharia Law, says he will bring new bill amid H-1B row
item.description: Congressman Chip Roy plans to introduce the PAUSE Act, proposing a complete halt to immigration until the US system is reformed. This comes amid controversy over President Trump's remarks on needing foreign talent, despite recent H-1B visa fee hikes. ​"Why are we importing any human being that is adhering to Sharia law which is totally contrary to the Constitution. We can amend the bill but I am going to introduce a framework why don't we just freeze immigration entirely until we sort this crap out," he said.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: '30 Americans and 3 H-1Bs vs 30 Indians': Ben Shapiro draws flak for defending H-1B, says his words taken out of context
item.description: Conservative commentator Ben Shapiro faced backlash for defending the H-1B visa program, which critics claim harms American jobs. Shapiro clarified his remarks, explaining H-1B's connection to labor costs and job retention in the US. He argued that while the system has flaws, America benefits from attracting global talent, provided they assimilate.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Iran: As traffic chokes Tehran, Women turn to motorbikes despite the ban
item.description: Tehran women are challenging long-standing social and legal restrictions by riding motorbikes through the city. Café owner Merat Behnam navigates the congested streets daily, facing potential disapproval and police scrutiny. What began as a practical solution to traffic and parking challenges has become a symbol of independence and choice, reflecting a subtle but significant shift in societal attitudes toward women in Iran
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'We live in a fascist country': American Airlines flight diverted over passenger's outburst; 4 Congressmen were flying to vote on shutdown
item.description: Midway through their flight to Washington DC, an American Airlines plane carrying four Arizona Congressmen made an unexpected detour to Kansas. The reason? A disruptive woman on board proclaimed that she was living in a 'fascist country.' Law enforcement promptly intervened, ensuring her removal from the plane.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: The Zohran Effect: 50,000 apply to work in Mamdani's administration
item.description: New York City's mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani has seen an unprecedented 50,000 applications for administrative roles, signaling strong public enthusiasm for his 'working people first' agenda. This surge, coupled with impressive fundraising, highlights a significant political shift and a desire for grassroots involvement in governing the city. Early appointments suggest a focus on fiscal experience and continuity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
